mapper.select:
SELECT C.CHK_ID AS chkId, C.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, C.CHK_TYPE AS chkType, TC.CODE_NM AS chkTypeNm, TO_CHAR(C.CHK_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS chkDt, C.CHKR_ID AS chkrId, C.RESULT AS result, RC.CODE_NM AS resultNm, C.REMARK AS remark, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_CHECK_ITEM IT WHERE IT.CHK_ID = C.CHK_ID) AS itemCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_CHECK_ITEM IT WHERE IT.CHK_ID = C.CHK_ID AND IT.ITEM_RESULT = 'ABNORMAL') AS abnormalCnt FROM OPS_CHECK C LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON C.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP = 'CHECK_TYPE' AND TC.CODE_ID = C.CHK_TYPE LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE RC ON RC.CODE_GRP = 'CHECK_RESULT' AND RC.CODE_ID = C.RESULT WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY C.CHK_ID DESC OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_CHECK C WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT C.CHK_ID AS chkId, C.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, C.CHK_TYPE AS chkType, TC.CODE_NM AS chkTypeNm, TO_CHAR(C.CHK_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS chkDt, C.CHKR_ID AS chkrId, C.RESULT AS result, RC.CODE_NM AS resultNm, C.REMARK AS remark, TO_CHAR(C.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regDt FROM OPS_CHECK C LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON C.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP = 'CHECK_TYPE' AND TC.CODE_ID = C.CHK_TYPE LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE RC ON RC.CODE_GRP = 'CHECK_RESULT' AND RC.CODE_ID = C.RESULT WHERE C.CHK_ID = #{chkId}
SELECT IT.ITEM_ID AS itemId, IT.CHK_ID AS chkId, IT.ITEM_NM AS itemNm, IT.ITEM_RESULT AS itemResult, IT.ITEM_REMARK AS itemRemark FROM OPS_CHECK_ITEM IT WHERE IT.CHK_ID = #{chkId} ORDER BY IT.ITEM_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_CHECK (SYS_ID, CHK_TYPE, CHK_DT, CHKR_ID, RESULT, REMARK, REG_DT) VALUES (#{sysId}, #{chkType}, TO_DATE(#{chkDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')CURRENT_DATE, #{chkrId}, #{result}, #{remark}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
INSERT INTO OPS_CHECK_ITEM (CHK_ID, ITEM_NM, ITEM_RESULT, ITEM_REMARK) VALUES (#{chkId}, #{itemNm}, #{itemResult}, #{itemRemark})
